field.name: Name
field.urlHint: Events are POSTed to this URL. It must be https and must not point to an internal network.

list.title: Webhooks
list.description: Notify external systems (CI, chat tools, your own services) with a POST when users, approvals or files change. Payloads only carry ids; receivers look up details with an API token.

create.title: Create webhook
create.description: A signing secret is generated so the receiver can verify that requests come from here.

delete.title: Delete webhook
delete.confirm: After deleting "{{name}}", no more events are sent and its delivery log is deleted too. This can't be undone.

secret.warning: This signing secret is shown only once. Copy it to the receiver now; if you lose it, rotate to get a new one.
secret.verifyHint: To verify: compute HMAC-SHA256 with the secret over the X-Webhook-Timestamp value + "." + the raw body, compare it with the part after sha256= in X-Webhook-Signature, and reject requests with old timestamps.
secret.rotateConfirm: After rotating, "{{name}}" is signed with a new secret right away and the old one stops working. Update the receiver first, or it will reject the requests that follow.

detail.title: Webhook
detail.deliveriesHint: One entry per attempt, kept for 30 days. Failures are retried automatically (up to 8 times, backing off to 1 hour).
detail.failingNotice: Turned off after {{count}} failures in a row. Fix the receiver, send a test event to confirm, then turn it back on.

userCreated.name: User created
userCreated.description: An admin creates an account, a sign-up is approved, or someone signs in through an external IdP for the first time.

userStatusChanged.name: User status changed
userStatusChanged.description: Turned off, turned on, locked, unlocked or activated; includes the old and new status.

userDeleted.name: User deleted
userDeleted.description: A user is deleted (can be restored from the trash).

userRestored.name: User restored
userRestored.description: A user is restored from the trash.

approvalDecided.name: Approval decided
approvalDecided.description: A request is approved or rejected.

fileUploaded.name: File uploaded
fileUploaded.description: A file finishes uploading and its content is verified.
